messages:
Anna: Heads-up: planning a rolling deploy of autoscaler policy v3 to dedicated-gpu-pool-east (not the prod pool) at 03:00 UTC tonight. Will canary on 2 nodes first.
Mike: Got it. Which nodes specifically?
Anna: canary label = pool=dedicated-gpu-east-canary (2 g4dn nodes). Full roll starts after 30m successful smoke.
Sarah: What are the main changes in v3?
Anna: - increase min_replicas from 2 -> 4 for better burst headroom
- new target_utilization metric uses p95 GPU util instead of avg
- safe_fallback: route to model-2b-quant when capacity low
Mike: Any config snippet I can eyeball?
Anna: paste below:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: autoscaler-policy-v3
data:
  policy: |
    min_replicas: 4
    target_p95_util: 0.72
    canary_replicas: 2
    fallback_model: model-2b-quant
```
Liam: Who's running the smoke tests and do we have scripts?
Anna: @Sarah will run smoke checks. Script is in infra/playbooks/smoke/gpu_pool_check.sh — basic flow: health endpoints, 1k token gen load at p10/p95 latency checks, KV cache warmup.
Sarah: Yep, I'll run smoke. Main checkpoints: 1) health OK across canary nodes 2) p95 latency < 200ms for sample prompt set 3) no OOMs in dmesg/logs 4) model fallback works.
Eva: How do we rollback if something fails?
Anna: Rollback plan: immediate pause and rollback policy on controller, then revert autoscaler config to v2 and scale down to previous min_replicas. Commands:
```bash
# pause rollout
kubectl annotate deployment/gpu-autoscaler rollout-pause=true -n inference
# rollback config
kubectl apply -f autoscaler-policy-v2.yaml -n inference
# undo deployment if needed
kubectl rollout undo deployment/gpu-autoscaler -n inference
```
Mike: Do we need to notify customers or support?
Anna: This is internal-dedicated pool only; no public API change. I'll ping Support+CS channel after canary success.
devops-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: deploy-autoscaler-v3 -> canary nodes (2) at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z. CI: green.
Sarah: I'll post smoke results here with timestamps and attach logs. If anything > 250ms p95 or OOMs, I trigger rollback and tag @Anna @Mike.
Liam: Can we add an alert to SRE for GPU OOM spikes during the window?
Anna: Yes adding alert rule now: gpu.oom.count > 3 within 5m => pager.
Eva: One last ask: confirm model fallback latency penalty so we can set SLOs appropriately.
Anna: Fallback adds ~30-40ms; we'll include that in the smoke report.
Mike: LGTM — I can be on-call to help rollback if Sarah calls it. :+1:
Sarah: Cool. I'll start smoke at 03:05 UTC after canary is live and post quick pass/fail in ~10m.
Anna: Thanks all. Tagging runbook: runbooks/gpu_pool_autoscale.md — follow steps 1-7 for rollout/rollback. :shipit:
